title: Define private GitOps source and Vault credential boundary
classification_reason: defines GitOps repository trust and secret-delivery architecture
constrains future Vault and Argo CD access
expected_outcome: A versioned contract makes private ECR OCI the only Argo CD source, reserves GitHub App credentials for a future mirror path, and prohibits secret material or Application deployment until Vault and VSO contracts are separately approved.
constraints: No NAT, public endpoint, Vault initialization, Vault unseal, GitHub App creation, private-key handling, Kubernetes Secret creation, or Argo CD Application deployment.
Argo CD must not connect directly to github.com from the private VPC.

external_actions: read non-sensitive Argo CD and AWS resource status

primary_owner.responsibility: source trust and Vault boundary integration
